trap.label: so vs because
trap.wrong: I was late so the bus was slow.
trap.right: I was late because the bus was slow.
trap.why: Em português usamos 'então/porque' sem fixar a ordem; o aluno troca. Because dá a causa, so dá o resultado.

mcq.q: It's raining, ___ I take an umbrella.
I want to go, ___ I'm tired.

fix.wrong: I was sick so I stayed home.
fix.right: I was sick, so I stayed home.

fix.wrong: I like fish or I don't like rice.
fix.right: I like fish but I don't like rice.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com so: “I'm cold. I close the window.”
rewrite.answer: I'm cold so I close the window.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com because: “I'm happy. It's my birthday.”
rewrite.answer: I'm happy because it's my birthday.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com or: “Do you want tea? Do you want coffee?”
rewrite.answer: Do you want tea or coffee?
